snippet.title: CMiG | Absolution - The Sequel To Alida (Trailer) (2026)
snippet.description:
The sequel to Alida is almost finished. Cos Russo has devoted more than seven years on this project, and is very excited about sharing it  with you. Absolution will be available through Steam for PC on September 1 2026.

https://www.alidagame.com/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4455860/Absolution__The_Sequel_To_Alida/

For those not in the loop what was ALIDA ... well its was a achievement in itself . When one person in 5 years made a game , that came in 2004 ... https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7p7woMOvKTA

PS. In a funny tidbit, the game itself inspired another dev to make Neyyah  (one guy , 6,5 years) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4TEngcIBG6g

This Video is a part of my Cynical Games Review Site : https://gbacklog.blogspot.com/
